description: ⚠️ Destructive: Unlink an action from a trigger (DELETE /ncf/api/v2/triggers/{name}/link-action). The trigger stops invoking the action; neither resource is deleted. Set confirm=true to execute.

actionName.description: Action name. '{packageName}/{actionName}' is also accepted and split automatically.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually execute the destructive operation

platform.description: Platform (default: vpc). Singapore/Japan regions support vpc only.

name: ncloud_functions_unlink_trigger_action
